Two separate no-cost allowances — one for records, one for files.

Speed Up Loading Master Only

Older files are stored inside the database itself, so the app downloads every one of them before it can open. Moving them to Firebase Storage means only a small link is loaded instead.

—

Full Data Backup

One Excel file, one sheet per section (Inventory, HH Inventory, Exchange Stock, Price List, Accessories, Finance Schemes, Finance Categories, Chalans, Customers, Important Info, Model Aliases, Events, Storage Areas) — a snapshot to keep on your own device, separate from Firebase. Anyone can download this — it's read-only and never touches live data.

Restore From Backup Master Only

Upload a Full Backup .xlsx file to add its records back in. This only adds — it never deletes or overwrites anything already here, so restoring a backup is safe to do more than once (though re-adding the same rows twice will create duplicates, so only restore what's actually missing).
